title: Battle of Laon
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Laon", at revision 1370267889, opens: "The Battle of Laon, fought on March 9–10, 1814, was a pivotal engagement during the waning months of the Napoleonic Wars. Blücher's Prusso-Russian force, occupying a tough defensive position at the town of Laon, repelled attacks by and successfully counterattacked French Emperor Napoleon and his subordinate corps commander, Marshal Marmont." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q426026, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1814 battle during the War of the Sixth Coalition". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
